svg.title: NCOS architecture mapped to an operating system
svg.desc: User space contains the teacher portal and apps. Kernel space contains the curriculum engine with subsystems for indicator management, scheduling, and document drivers. Below that, the curriculum data acts as the file system, and NaCCA source PDFs are the boot source.
svg.text: NCOS API — the system call interface

g.text: data/curriculum — indicators, strands, grades as the on-disk structure
Parsed once at "install time" into the curriculum asset
